title.full: Other ways to pay for vaccination

summary.text: There are two options: full subsidy at CHAS GP clinics for Public Assistance card holders, or help from a polyclinic social worker.

details.heading: CHAS GP clinics
details.body: These nationally recommended vaccinations are fully subsidised if you hold the Public Assistance card.

details.heading: Polyclinics
details.body: If you go to a polyclinic for your vaccination and have difficulty paying your bill, approach the social worker there to ask about assistance.

example_phrasings: If I cannot afford the remaining vaccination co-payment, what other help is there?
Can I get the vaccination without paying the full remaining amount?
Are there other ways to receive the vaccination if I do not have enough in my MediSave?

sources.page_title: If I do not have enough in my MediSave, and I am not able to pay the remaining co-payment, are there other ways to receive the vaccination?

quotes.text: At CHAS GP clinics, these nationally recommended vaccinations are fully subsidised for those who hold the Public Assistance card.
Patients who go to the polyclinics for their vaccination(s) and have financial difficulties in paying for their bills can approach the social worker at polyclinics to enquire for assistance.
